Select: molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, docs, compound_records, compound_structures. Join: docs to compound_records via doc_id, compound_records to molecule_dictionary via molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures via molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1122107'. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ascending.
